docs.note: the white paper is the map layer; this repository's copy is the audited snapshot, and the kit copy is the canonical source named by the PLAN source anchor

why: The CSS manifest is the original ASX format, and PLAN's canonical model calls CSS compression part of ASX symbolic compression law rather than a disconnected UI concern. It was ungated: nothing checked that the manifest still carries its key-grammar chain, its eight-stage syntax compiler, its seven syntax unit kinds, or — most importantly — that it declares itself normalization-only. The white paper also fixes what the compression operates on: 2D relation vectors scored by cosine, not semantic tensors.

pipeline.law: match → bind → filter → map → score → XCFE admission → K'UHUL phases → Ch'en observe → Xul commit

operators.filter: select the vectors whose score clears the declared threshold
operators.score: score the relation vector by cosine G(q,b) in R^2

pipeline.law_of_authority: compression and scoring never admit: the phase gate, XCFE admission and Xul commit remain the only authority, and the manifest states the same boundary itself

manifest_surface.syntax_compiler_note: the shipped manifest lists eight entries; the eighth is the compiler entry point, so the stage set below the entry is the seven named passes

two_d_contract.law: unigrams, bigrams and trigrams have distinct responsibilities: the field combines symbolic graph topology with numeric 2D geometry, and semantic references are not automatically numeric tensors

records.T3: stored phase theta plus an executable FoldRef

operators.fold: contract a set of 2D vectors into one structural record (centroid + extent), which is how key grammar folds a neighborhood
operators.map: transform each 2D vector under the declared key parameters (scale, rotate, translate)
operators.filter: select the vectors whose cosine G(q, b) clears the declared threshold

scxq2_relationship.law: SCXQ2 remains an optional distinct encoding/execution path and is not this format
scxq2_relationship.this_format: ASX key-grammar symbolic compression: keys, folds, neighborhoods and 2D relation vectors

invariants.AC1: the manifest declares the five required sections, and a missing or renamed section is a typed refusal rather than a silent gap
invariants.AC2: the key grammar keeps its key→book→grammar chain and declares only canonical C6 phases; an undeclared or aliased phase is refused
invariants.AC3: the syntax compiler keeps its declared stage set, in order; a missing or reordered pass is refused
invariants.AC4: every ⟁TYPE entry declares a kind from the seven syntax unit kinds, a css-bearing language (language:css for pure CSS units, language:html+css for composite units), and its glyph
invariants.AC5: the manifest is normalisation only: it declares `not:execution-authority`, and any entry claiming execution or commit authority is refused
invariants.AC6: the compression pipeline runs match → bind → filter → map → score and never skips the phase gate or the XCFE admission that follows it
invariants.AC7: 2D relation vectors live in R^2 and are scored by the cosine G(q, b); a vector is a relation vector and never silently becomes a semantic tensor
invariants.AC8: SCXQ2 stays a separate optional encoding path; this contract does not absorb it and does not claim its authority
invariants.AC9: one key expands into a declared field: expansion reads the records that declare their vectors, never invents a member, and an unnamed record is not part of a field
invariants.AC10: the field is deterministic: the signature is a function of (key, catalog version, sorted entries), the order is producer-then-ref, and the same inputs reproduce the same signature
invariants.AC11: a preset vector is either declared by its record or deterministically derived and labelled preset_derived; no learned embedding enters the expansion and W_learned stays separate
invariants.AC12: an application is not a special case: a unit of kind `application` expands into its own field of units and projects by the same HTMLBIND rule and SyntaxProjector stage

field_expansion.law: one key addresses a declared book, the book declares the neighbourhood, and unfolding the persistent graph yields an instance tree: a key expands into a whole field of preset vectors, it does not denote one style
field_expansion.model: vector-field compression by 2D word association: the key's association vector locates the field, and each member of the field carries the preset 2D vector its record declares

populated_by.cfpc: CfpcContextField — field_keys accumulated across BFS hops, reachable micronaut ids, and generated questions
populated_by.question: question engine records
populated_by.micronaut: micronaut registry / track records, including their declared vector.x/.y

preset_vectors.declared: a record that declares x/y contributes that preset verbatim (W_corpus)
preset_vectors.derived: a record that declares none contributes a deterministic point derived from (key, ref), labelled preset_derived rather than presented as declared
preset_vectors.learned: no learned embedding enters this path: W_learned stays a separate weight (W_effective = W_corpus × W_learned)

field_expansion.determinism: the field signature is sha256 over (key, catalog version, sorted entries), so one key plus one catalog revision reproduces exactly one field
field_expansion.apps: an application is the same mechanism one level up: a unit of kind `application` expands into its own field of units (snippet / block / component / layout) and projects through `⟁HTMLBIND` (html:element->css:key) and the SyntaxProjector stage
does_not: no interpretation: expansion materialises declared records, it does not invent members
no authority: the field is evidence for routing and projection, never an admission
